description: Compress image. Make a photo lighter — down to a size limit or by quality. Handy when a form refuses a large file. Accepts image/*, .heic, .heif, .avif; up to 50 MB per file.

format.description: Output format. «As is» keeps the original

maxWidth.description: Also cap the width, in pixels

outputDir.description: Where to put the results. Defaults to the folder each source file came from. Existing files are never overwritten.

paths.description: Paths to the files to process, absolute or relative to the working directory.

quality.description: Quality, 1–100. Used when no target size is set

targetKb.description: Target size in KB. Leave empty to use quality instead

name: image_compress
